name: Trilinear Volume Sampling for Texture Generation
definition: Samples a 3D attribute volume (color, material properties) at corrected 3D positions using trilinear interpolation, mapping world-space coordinates to volume grid space.
summary: Trilinear Volume Sampling retrieves attributes from a 3D voxel grid at continuous positions by interpolating the surrounding 2x2x2 neighborhood, enabling direct surface queries without UV mapping.
